section.title: org.osgi.service.dal.functions.data
section.para: Device Abstraction Layer Functions Data Package 1.0.

Bundles wishing to use this package must list the package in the Import-Package header of the bundle's manifest. This package has two types of users: the consumers that use the API in this package and the providers that implement the API in this package.
Example import for consumers using the API in this package:
Example import for providers implementing the API in this package:

listitem.para: AlarmData - Function alarm data.
BooleanData - Function boolean data wrapper.
KeypadData - Represents a keypad event data that is collected when a change with some key from the keypad has occurred.
LevelData - Function level data wrapper.

section.title: public class AlarmData extends FunctionData
section.para: Function alarm data. It cares about the alarm type, severity, timestamp and additional metadata. It doesn't support unit. The alarm type is mapped to FunctionData value.

formalpara.title: See Also
formalpara.para: Alarm, FunctionData

section.title: public static final String FIELD_SEVERITY = "severity"
section.para: Represents the severity field name. The field value is available with getSeverity(). The field type is int. The constant can be used as a key to AlarmData(Map) .

section.title: public static final String FIELD_TYPE = "type"
section.para: Represents the type field name. The field value is available with getType(). The field type is int. The constant can be used as a key to AlarmData(Map).

section.title: public static final int SEVERITY_CRITICAL = 3
section.para: The severity rating indicates that there a critical alarm. The severity priority is higher than SEVERITY_MINOR and SEVERITY_MAJOR.

section.title: public static final int SEVERITY_MAJOR = 2
section.para: The severity rating indicates that there is a major alarm. The severity priority is higher than SEVERITY_MINOR and lower than SEVERITY_CRITICAL.

section.title: public static final int SEVERITY_MINOR = 1
section.para: The severity rating indicates that there is a minor alarm. The severity priority is lower than SEVERITY_MAJOR and SEVERITY_CRITICAL.

section.title: public static final int SEVERITY_UNDEFINED = 0
section.para: The severity constant indicates that there is no severity rating for this alarm.

section.title: public static final int TYPE_ACCESS_CONTROL = 1
section.para: The alarm type indicates that there is access control issue. For example, the alarm can indicate that the door is unlocked.

section.title: public static final int TYPE_BURGLAR = 2
section.para: The alarm type indicates that there is a burglar notification. For example, the alarm can indicate that the glass is broken.

section.title: public static final int TYPE_COLD = 3
section.para: The alarm type indicates that temperature is too low.

section.title: public static final int TYPE_GAS_CO = 4
section.para: The alarm type indicates that carbon monoxide (CO) is detected.

section.title: public static final int TYPE_GAS_CO2 = 5
section.para: The alarm type indicates that carbon dioxide (CO2) is detected.

section.title: public static final int TYPE_HARDWARE_FAIL = 7
section.para: The alarm type indicates that there is hardware failure.

section.title: public static final int TYPE_HEAT = 6
section.para: The alarm type indicates that temperature is too high.

section.title: public static final int TYPE_POWER_FAIL = 8
section.para: The alarm type indicates a power cut.

section.title: public static final int TYPE_SMOKE = 9
section.para: The alarm type indicates that smoke is detected.

section.title: public static final int TYPE_SOFTWARE_FAIL = 10
section.para: The alarm type indicates that there is software failure.

section.title: public static final int TYPE_TAMPER = 11
section.para: The alarm type for a tamper indication.

section.title: public static final int TYPE_UNDEFINED = 0
section.para: The alarm type indicates that the type is not specified.

section.title: public static final int TYPE_WATER = 12
section.para: The alarm type indicates that a water leak is detected.

section.title: public AlarmData(Map<String, ?> fields)

formalpara.title: fields
formalpara.para: Contains the new AlarmData instance field values.

section.para: Constructs new AlarmData instance with the specified field values. The map keys must match to the field names. The map values will be assigned to the appropriate class fields. For example, the maps can be: {"severity"=Integer(1)...}. That map will initialize the FIELD_SEVERITY field with 1. If severity is missing, SEVERITY_UNDEFINED is used.

listitem.para: FIELD_SEVERITY - optional field. The value type must be Integer.
FIELD_TYPE - optional field. The value type must be Integer.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: IllegalArgumentException– If the alarm severity is invalid.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: NullPointerException– If the fields map is null.

section.title: public class KeypadData extends FunctionData
section.para: Represents a keypad event data that is collected when a change with some key from the keypad has occurred.
The key pressed event is using TYPE_PRESSED type, while the key released event is using TYPE_RELEASED type.

formalpara.title: See Also
formalpara.para: Keypad, FunctionData

section.title: public static final String FIELD_KEY_CODE = "keyCode"
section.para: Represents the key code field name. The field value is available with getKeyCode(). The field type is int . The constant can be used as a key to KeypadData(Map).

section.title: public static final String FIELD_KEY_NAME = "keyName"
section.para: Represents the key name field name. The field value is available with getKeyName(). The field type is String. The constant can be used as a key to KeypadData(Map).

section.title: public static final String FIELD_SUB_TYPE = "subType"
section.para: Represents the event sub-type field name. The field value is available with getSubType(). The field type is int. The constant can be used as a key to KeypadData(Map).

section.title: public static final String FIELD_TYPE = "type"
section.para: Represents the event type field name. The field value is available with getType(). The field type is int. The constant can be used as a key to KeypadData(Map).

section.title: public static final int SUB_TYPE_PRESSED_DOUBLE = 3
section.para: Represents a keypad event sub-type for a double key pressed event. Usually, there are two press actions and the key is not held down after the second press. This sub-type is used with TYPE_PRESSED type.

section.title: public static final int SUB_TYPE_PRESSED_DOUBLE_LONG = 4
section.para: Represents a keypad event sub-type for a double long key pressed event. Usually, there are two press actions and the key is held down after the second press. This sub-type is used with TYPE_PRESSED type.

section.title: public static final int SUB_TYPE_PRESSED_LONG = 2
section.para: Represents a keypad event sub-type for a long key pressed event. Usually, there is a single press and the key is held down. This sub-type is used with TYPE_PRESSED type.

section.title: public static final int SUB_TYPE_PRESSED_NORMAL = 1
section.para: Represents a keypad event sub-type for a normal key pressed event. Usually, there is a single press and the key is not held down. This sub-type is used with TYPE_PRESSED type.

section.title: public static final int TYPE_PRESSED = 0
section.para: Represents a keypad event type for a key pressed event.

section.title: public static final int TYPE_RELEASED = 1
section.para: Represents a keypad event type for a key released event.

listitem.para: FIELD_TYPE - mandatory field. The value type must be Integer.
FIELD_SUB_TYPE - optional field. The value type must be Integer.
FIELD_KEY_CODE - mandatory field. The value type must be Integer.
FIELD_KEY_NAME - optional field. The value type must be String.
